question: Each of six sports persons, Falak, Bala, Renu, Rekha, Priya and Pallavi, has a different weight. Rekha is heavier than only Falak and Renu but lighter than Bala and Priya. Pallavi is the heaviest. Priya is heavier than Bala and Falak is heavier than Renu. Who is the lightest among all the sports persons?
solution:
**Given: **Each of six sports persons, Falak, Bala, Renu, Rekha, Priya and Pallavi, has a different weight. 

1) Pallavi is the heaviest.

Pallavi > _ > _ > _ > _ > _

2) Rekha is heavier than only Falak and Renu but lighter than Bala and Priya.

Pallavi > Bala/Priya > Bala/Priya > Rekha > Falak/Renu > Falak/Renu</spa
